column2: There's something there? I don't quite understand, but if you tell me to go, I'll go...
I understand. I don't know what's there, but I have to go, don't I?{wait}{clear}A trip like that might be nice once in a while. I'm off, Angel.
What am I going there for?{wait}{clear}Oh, I'm sorry, Angel... You must have something in mind, don't you?{wait}{clear}I'm sure I'll understand once I go, right? I'm off.
I don't quite know why, but I should head there?{wait}{clear}I understand, I'll go and see, anyway.
I understand, I'll go and see anyway, Angel. I'm sure I'll find something out once I'm there, right?
